+
+This is future implementation acceptance for Axxium issue 6, UUID `axxium-knoxx-identity-migration`, unchanged Todo/P0/8. Axxium currently uses npm/package-lock and Knoxx pnpm; retain those policies. Record full current source and mandatory suite discovery, not an old test count or compiler exit alone. Review actor row/claim normalization, issuer/audience/key trust, authenticated capability mapping/freshness, cookie routing/CSRF and existing account migration/rollback choices before code.
+
+## Full requirement matrix and meaningful RED controls
+
+| Original obligation | Required positive proof | Required refusal, failure and concurrency controls |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Axxium OAuth/login authentication | Real owning Axxium login route plus Knoxx's actual trusted request hook/routes and each browser/machine flow; preserve current approved login during explicit coexistence, then qualified Axxium-only final mode | Denied/timeout/unavailable/malformed authority, wrong origin, redirect, caller-chosen endpoint, unsafe return target, invalid signup/invite/bootstrap or provider callback. No local password/header fallback after refusal. Inventory and prove every existing auth flow, not password login alone. |
+| Axxium Bearer tokens | Exact issuer/audience/algorithm/key and token-kind verification with current actor/session status; typed principal reaches actual consuming route before effects | Tampering, wrong issuer/audience/algorithm/key, expired/future/revoked token, inactive actor, malformed/empty/multiple credentials, cookie/Bearer conflict and status outage. A syntactically decoded token is a negative control, not verified identity. |
+| Axxium capabilities as policy input | Fresh mapped grant plus current tenant/membership/resource policy allows exact legitimate operation; audit actor/authority/reason without tokens | Missing/unmapped/revoked/stale capability, forged role/admin flag or x-knoxx header, disabled membership, cross-tenant/resource access, actor-binding mismatch and policy outage refuse before DB/tool/conversation effects. Current local policy never widens the identity grant. |
+| Axxium cookies in Knoxx UI | Actual mounted CLJS auth boundary and remaining shared TS context see Axxium-backed session, refresh, expiry and logout; HttpOnly credential omitted from JS projections | Unauthenticated (401), revoked/expired session, wrong cookie scope, cross-origin/CSRF mutation, logout failure, conflicting Bearer and loading/error transition. Real browser cookie jar/tour must prove routing, not a fake UI context or copied Set-Cookie text. |
+| Existing users without re-registration | Every supported legacy kind: password/scrypt, provider-only, invite/member/multiple-org, bootstrap and machine actor; stable resource and actor attribution with authenticated migration binding | Same email/different subjects, existing Axxium collision, disabled user, incompatible credential algorithm, duplicate import, concurrent import/login, partial transaction/network failure, retry and rollback. +| Remove auth_session/authz and standalone auth tables | Qualified final admission uses only Axxium auth; legacy compatibility/module imports/routes, credential/session collections/indexes and recreating bootstrap/writers are gone; retained business policy/projections have explicit non-authenticating purpose | Deliberate legacy writer/route/import recreation is detected. Removal/rollback tests prove no stranded user, deleted resource attribution, lost tenant check or restored revoked privilege. |
+
+## Explicit status and rollback verification additions
+
+The proposed Axxium-owned `POST /api/auth/introspect`, `axxium.identity-status.v1` contract in the design is a prerequisite, not a currently implemented `/api/auth/me` feature. On both portable hosts, test exact version/authority/actor/session/capability/time shapes and distinguish rejected/expired/revoked/inactive authentication (401), verified insufficient grant/policy (403), and unknown/unimplemented/unavailable/malformed or untrusted status evidence (503). Axxium-side actual endpoint fixtures inject verifier/database failure and assert retryable refusal rather than 401; absent/expired/revoked sessions retain their distinct rejected reason. Knoxx-side real request/UI fixtures keep loading/retryable error separate from signed-out and prove no stale capability, forged source, cookie/Bearer conflict, cache expiry or unknown version can admit DB/tool/conversation effects. A HTTP 200/shape-only positive and a decoded token without authority are deliberate negative controls.
